parsed_json.up: Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno; molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4; drug_indication.efo_id IS NOT NULL; drug_indication.efo_term IS NOT NULL. Deduplication: Return DISTINCT rows for the selected columns. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
